item.description:
### Added
- **Review and clean caches and build output in a native window.** Handbyte scans the same locations as the `handbyte` CLI, groups what it finds by application and project, and explains what each item is before you act. - **Nothing is removed without a confirmation.** Items move to the Trash with Finder "Put Back" information by default. Permanent deletion is a separate setting and asks again before every cleanup. - **Safety tiers tell apart what can be cleaned at once and what needs a look.** Items that a running app still uses or that are not regenerable are held back and shown with the reason. - **Settings for the minimum size, project roots and exclusions.** Mark any item "Never Clean This" from its detail pane. - **In-app updates.** Handbyte checks for new versions and installs them with Sparkle.
